name: Exp_RVI_Histogram
summary: This EA trades based on the RVI (Relative Vigor Index) Histogram indicator, supporting two signal modes: level-based and crossover-based. It opens buy positions when the RVI histogram signals upward momentum and sell positions on downward momentum, with configurable position closing on opposite signals. Money management is handled via the TradeAlgorithms library with multiple margin modes.
summary_zh: 该EA基于RVI直方图指标进行交易，支持两种信号模式：基于水平线和基于交叉。当RVI直方图发出上涨动量信号时开多仓，发出下跌动量信号时开空仓，并可在反向信号时平仓。资金管理通过TradeAlgorithms库实现，支持多种保证金模式。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的策略核心是RVI（相对活力指数）直方图指标，用于衡量市场动量方向。入场条件分两种模式：水平模式（Levels）下，当直方图颜色索引为0（看涨）时做多，索引为2（看跌）时做空；交叉模式（Cross）下，当RVI信号线上穿触发线时做多，下穿时做空。出场条件依赖反向信号触发平仓，即多头持仓遇到看跌信号时平多，空头持仓遇到看涨信号时平空。仓位管理通过MM参数控制风险比例，支持按自由保证金、余额、损失后余额等多种模式计算手数。止损和止盈分别固定为1000和2000点，但未考虑点差过滤和滑点保护（仅有Deviation参数）。整体策略逻辑清晰但较为简单，缺乏对市场波动性和流动性的动态适应。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is based on the RVI (Relative Vigor Index) Histogram indicator, which measures market momentum direction. Entry conditions operate in two modes: in Levels mode, a long position is opened when the histogram color index is 0 (bullish) and a short when it is 2 (bearish); in Cross mode, a long is triggered when the RVI signal line crosses above the trigger line, and a short when it crosses below. Exit conditions rely on opposing signals — long positions are closed on bearish signals and short positions on bullish signals. Position sizing is controlled via the MM parameter with support for multiple margin calculation modes including free margin, balance, loss-adjusted balance, and fixed lot. Stop loss and take profit are fixed at 1000 and 2000 points respectively, with no spread filter or dynamic volatility adaptation. The overall strategy logic is clear but relatively simplistic, lacking dynamic adjustment for market volatility and liquidity conditions.

pros: 双信号模式设计灵活，用户可根据市场状态选择水平线或交叉模式
支持多种资金管理模式，适应不同风险偏好和账户规模
止损止盈参数可配置，基本风险控制框架完备
可独立控制买卖方向的开仓和平仓，灵活性高
使用自定义指标句柄，代码架构清晰模块化
pros_en: Dual signal mode design is flexible, allowing users to choose between level-based or crossover-based signals depending on market conditions
Supports multiple money management modes, adapting to different risk preferences and account sizes
Configurable stop loss and take profit parameters provide a basic risk control framework
Independent control over buy/sell opening and closing offers high flexibility
Uses custom indicator handle with clean, modular code architecture
cons: 缺乏点差过滤，在高点差环境下可能产生虚假信号导致亏损
止损止盈为固定点数，未根据市场波动性（ATR等）动态调整
依赖外部TradeAlgorithms库和自定义RVI_Histogram指标，可移植性差
没有持仓数量检查，可能在同方向重复开仓
SignalBar参数默认为1但允许为0，可能导致当前未完成K线的虚假信号
缺少回撤控制和最大亏损保护机制
cons_en: No spread filter, which may cause false signals and losses in high-spread environments
Fixed stop loss and take profit in points without dynamic adjustment based on market volatility (e.g., ATR)
Depends on external TradeAlgorithms library and custom RVI_Histogram indicator, reducing portability
No position count check, potentially allowing duplicate entries in the same direction
SignalBar parameter defaults to 1 but allows 0, which may trigger signals on incomplete current bars
Lacks drawdown control and maximum loss protection mechanisms
improvements: 增加点差过滤和波动性自适应止损止盈（如基于ATR动态计算）
添加持仓数量限制和同方向重复开仓检查
增加最大回撤保护和连续亏损后的仓位缩减机制
improvements_en: Add spread filter and volatility-adaptive stop loss/take profit (e.g., ATR-based dynamic calculation)
Add position count limits and duplicate same-direction entry checks
Add maximum drawdown protection and position reduction after consecutive losses

risk_points: 固定止损止盈未考虑市场波动性变化，可能在剧烈行情中止损过小或止盈过大
缺少点差过滤，低流动性时段可能以不利价格成交
SignalBar=0时使用未完成K线可能产生频繁虚假信号
未检查当前持仓数量，可能同方向重复开仓导致过度暴露
risk_points_en: Fixed stop loss/take profit doesn't account for volatility changes, potentially too tight or too loose in volatile markets
No spread filter may result in unfavorable fills during low-liquidity periods
SignalBar=0 uses incomplete bars, potentially generating frequent false signals
No current position count check may cause duplicate same-direction entries leading to overexposure
